audience: Spanish sole traders and small companies that invoice and keep books in Cuéntica

useCases.title: Review sales invoices
useCases.text: List sales invoices, issued or drafts, then open one for its lines, charges and register details.

useCases.title: Get the public preview link of an invoice
useCases.text: Get the public preview link of an invoice. The preview has the payment button for the company's Stripe account.

useCases.title: Review expenses from a provider
useCases.text: Search providers by name or tax id, then list expenses, including drafts if needed, and open one by id.

useCases.title: Review incomes and company accounts
useCases.text: List incomes, the records of money received, and the company's bank and card accounts.

useCases.title: Add a customer or provider
useCases.text: Search customers or providers first. Then create the record with its business type, address, town and postal code.
